note: Leech Lake resort on Sugar Point: the RV sites sit on an open lawn behind the row of lakefront cabins. Protected harbor, boat rentals and slips, indoor pool, playgrounds. --Claude
summary: Operator camping page + 2026 rate sheet read: full-hookup RV sites $62 (1-4 people, +$12 extra), 30/50 A, 110-V electric-only $55 and primitive $48, showers, laundry, phone/email booking with full non-refundable prepayment; 'all sizes' of RV. Over the $50 gate with no Good Sam Park listing and no gateway within 40 km: price drop candidate. Sheet also heads '3-4 NIGHT MINIMUM'. Pin is ~370 m south of the campground lawn.
